snippet.title: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage | LAUNCH TRAILER - Tape 2
snippet.description:
Lost Records: Bloom & Rage, the new narrative adventure from the original creators of Life is Strange, is out NOW on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5. Tape 2 “Rage”, out today as a free update, completes the thrilling two-part story. 

Steam: https://bit.ly/LRBR_Steam  
PlayStation Store: https://bit.ly/LRBR_PS5  
Xbox Store: https://bit.ly/LRBR_XBOX  
 
About the game:  
 
Lost Records: Bloom & Rage is an innovative narrative adventure game set over two timelines, following four high school girls who form lasting friendships over the summer, only to face a mysterious event that will change them forever.  

Reunited, they must piece together what was real, what really happened back then, and what lies festering under the surface of Velvet Cove...
